summary.text: Victoria Spartz is the Republican incumbent for Indiana's 5th District. Born in Ukraine, she immigrated to the United States in 2000, worked as an accountant and finance executive and started several businesses, served in the Indiana Senate from 2017 to 2020, and was elected to Congress in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Born in Nosivka, Ukraine, in 1978; immigrated to the United States in 2000 after meeting her husband, Jason, and became a U.S. citizen, according to her official biography.

Earned a bachelor's degree in international economics and an MBA from the National University of Economics in Ukraine, and a Master of Professional Accountancy (listed by Ballotpedia as an M.P.A.) from Indiana University's Kelley School of Business in 2006; also completed a Harvard Business School executive education program on health care.

Worked as a certified public accountant and auditor, including at Big 4 public accounting firms for Fortune 500 companies, and taught as an adjunct faculty member at Indiana University's Kelley School of Business.
Served as chief financial officer at the Indiana Attorney General's Office and started several businesses in financial consulting, farming and real estate, according to her official biography.
Served in the Indiana Senate (District 20) from 2017 to 2020.
Elected to the U.S. House in 2020 and took office in 2021, succeeding Rep. Susan Brooks; re-elected in 2022 and 2024.

Serves on the Joint Economic Committee in the 119th Congress and, according to her official biography, leads working groups on healthcare and budget reforms; previously served on the House Judiciary Committee.
Lives in Noblesville with her husband, Jason, and their two daughters, according to her official biography.
